topics.label: Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecturer, module overview, and core learning objectives before substantive lecture content begins.

topics.label: Cancer Etiology and Epidemiological Evidence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce fundamental concepts of cancer development, examining how genetic mutations, endogenous processes, environmental exposures, and epidemiological data explain cancer incidence.

topics.label: Oncogenic Pathogens and Burkitt Lymphoma
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how infectious agents promote cancer development, using Burkitt lymphoma as a detailed case study of pathogen-driven oncogenesis.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Chemical and Physical Mutagens
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how specific chemical compounds and physical radiation undergo metabolic activation and induce DNA damage.

topics.label: Tumor Promotion, Inflammation, and Host Susceptibility
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore non-mutagenic mechanisms of carcinogenesis, focusing on the distinction between initiators and promoters, chronic inflammation, and host developmental susceptibility.

topics.label: Identifying and Assessing Carcinogens
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the experimental, genomic, and epidemiological methodologies used to detect carcinogenicity and assess cancer risk.
